name: Sand Whip

Keep key subject in central 70%, no important details near edges. No card frame, no text or lettering or readable writing, no numbers, no UI, no logo, no watermark. No flat vector art, no modern objects, no gore. New standalone artwork.
Card identity: Sand Whip (sand_whip). Create a distinctive concrete visual interpretation of this specific title and effect. Dynamic scene of the named power manifesting, strong diagonal motion.
Gameplay meaning for visual storytelling only: Deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.
World: Mythic ancient Egyptian world, sandstone, lapis lazuli, gold, papyrus, turquoise magic and desert light.
